thread:
maya: FYI sales looped in a large customer asking for a 12mo reserved embedding commitment with per-route QPS and a monthly burst bucket. need product + infra + legal to scope.
alex: can we scope a minimal offering? propose: 'route reserve' add-on with per-route qps, burst credits, and a billing SKU. limit MVP to embeddings only.
sam: rough infra delta for 20 qps sustained embeddings -> ~15 GPU-hours/day delta at typical batch sizes. incremental cost estimate ~$15k/mo; need scheduler work for soft reservations + burst token buckets.
rachel: product acceptance criteria: 1) billing SKU & pricing bands, 2) console control for per-route qps, 3) API flag for reserved routing, 4) fallback routing to best-effort model, 5) runbook + canary.
ben: legal: avoid absolute uptime promises. suggest language: "commercially reasonable efforts" + defined credit formula and cap. also include cancellation notice terms and force majeure carveouts.
alex: sales wants three tiered offers: Starter (no reserve), Pro (reserved qps, no SLA), Enterprise (reserved qps + burst + SLA/support). need numbers to propose.
sam: initial pricing anchor: Pro ~ $11k/mo for 20 qps (covers infra + margin), Enterprise ~$26k/mo including SLA buffer. will finalise sensitivity table.
rachel: infra scope: scheduler + per-tenant token accounting + policy engine for fallback. estimate 3 infra sprints + monitoring dashboards.
maya: negotiation levers to propose to customer: cap monthly burst (e.g., 1M tokens), automatic fallback when exhausted, 30d cancellation notice. sales confirm?
ben: if customer insists on private deployment, legal needs KMS/data residency language and extra indemnities; that affects pricing.
ale x: owners: alex - term sheet; rachel - product spec; sam - cost model; maya - sales coordination; ben - contract draft.
legal-bot: created ticket PRD-788 for Route Reserve add-on (assignee: rachel).
maya: weekly sync Wednesdays 9am PT.
all: ack.
